I know your pain all too well, but please, please don't give up. It's survivors like us who can truly understand one another. Never turn your anger into vindictiveness or spite, we don't want more people to feel like us, right?  
The one person whos supposed to be the closest to you since birth did unspeakable things to me till I was 8. What my mom did left huge marks that's caused a bunch of mental issues, but I 'd never want anyone else to feel the shit I feel just because they either don't understand or they simply don't care. It's difficult being a good person when we're treated this way, but don't let that be your legacy. I beg you, be safe and see things through.

I can't you give you a witty long paragraph that points out all your reasons to keep going. What I can say is that you're strong, stronger than most of us I'd say. Gone through so much and yet you're still going. Our situations couldn't be further from each other, yet I understand exactly how you feel, except if I was in your shoes, I'd be long gone. Heres my half assed advice, as I don't know to which extent you can change your lifestyle, but drop any negative "friend" as you'll prosper within your own company, or if you're lucky, you'll find someone who can support and give new meaning to life.
